players.product: batch ALD/LPCVD deposition systems for DRAM

quarterly_data.signal: Q4 FY2026 revenue was JPY 62.02 billion, beating the forecast, and full-year revenue exceeded the previous forecast by JPY 5.1 billion, adjusted operating income by JPY 3.2 billion and adjusted net income by JPY 2.3 billion - although full-year revenue decreased 2% year-on-year and adjusted operating profit decreased 18%, on lower China DRAM equipment sales and upfront R&D/SG&A investment. Service revenue grew 27% year-on-year to 40% of total sales as upgrade modifications (mainly DRAM) replaced some new-equipment demand. Full-year equipment sales for NAND increased 90% and for DRAM 44%, while logic foundry decreased 11%. Annual dividend set at JPY 37; a share buyback of up to JPY 5.3 billion was resolved, and net cash of JPY 6.6 billion was achieved one year earlier than expected.
quarterly_data.figure: Q4 revenue JPY 62.02 billion; FY revenue -2% YoY but JPY 5.1 billion above forecast; service revenue +27% YoY (40% of sales); NAND equipment +90%, DRAM +44%, logic foundry -11%

quarterly_data.signal: Bookings in the fourth quarter were approximately JPY 104 billion and full-year bookings were JPY 264 billion, exceeding the company's assumption by about JPY 30 billion - the Q4 upswing was bigger than expected and may not yet be fully reflected in next year's sales forecast. The booking backlog at year-end was JPY 165 billion, and strong inquiry momentum is expected to continue into the year ending March 2027, with several clients asking to pull 2027 investment plans in earlier.
quarterly_data.figure: Q4 bookings ~JPY 104 billion; full-year bookings JPY 264 billion (~JPY 30 billion above assumption); year-end backlog JPY 165 billion

quarterly_data.signal: FY March 2027 guidance: revenue +19% year-on-year, adjusted operating profit +27%, adjusted net income +26%, with gross profit margin of 42%; annual dividend forecast JPY 47. Under the new classification (upgrade modifications, 200mm and used equipment moved from service into the equipment business), DRAM-related sales are expected to increase 36% year-on-year, logic foundry sales 38%, and NAND sales 7%; non-China equipment sales +39% while China equipment sales dip 3%, and the ratio of high-value-added products reaches 71%. The CY2026 WFE outlook was raised to 15% growth (up roughly 5 percentage points from the 10%+ view at Q3) on stronger AI-related investment; by application NAND +15%, DRAM +25% - +30%, logic foundry and others +5% - +10%; China -5%, non-China +20%.
quarterly_data.figure: FY March 2027 revenue +19%, adjusted OP +27%; DRAM sales +36%, logic foundry +38%, NAND +7%; WFE CY2026 raised to +15% (DRAM +25% - +30%)

quarterly_data.signal: Market position and POR pipeline: 2025 batch deposition market share rose 8 percentage points year-on-year to 49% (Gartner), and share of the batch ALD-compatible equipment segment reached 80%. In 3D NAND, 200-300-layer generation technology investment is expected to account for more than 80% of NAND-related equipment sales in FY March 2027, with PORs maintained and expanded for mini-batch deposition and single wafer treatment systems above 200 layers. In DRAM, D1C and D1D generation revenue is expected at roughly half of DRAM equipment revenue, with single wafer treatment PORs secured from the D1B generation onward and significant revenue growth expected; toward D0 and vertical channel transistor DRAM, more batch ALD adoption opportunities are expected. GAA sales were JPY 15 billion in FY March 2026 (below the JPY 20 billion forecast) and are forecast at JPY 20 billion for FY March 2027, with one first-generation 2-nanometer GAA POR already finalized and second-generation GAA PORs in competition. Advanced packaging revenue was JPY 3 billion and is expected at least at the same level. A U.S. demo center totaling JPY 20 billion opens in January 2027, and new land adjacent to the Tonami manufacturing center was acquired for production and R&D expansion.
quarterly_data.figure: Batch deposition share 49% (+8 points, 2025); batch ALD-compatible segment share 80%; GAA sales JPY 15 billion FY2026, JPY 20 billion forecast FY2027; U.S. demo center JPY 20 billion opening January 2027
